stories.title: Amazon cloud capacity sold out through 2027, CEO Jassy says
stories.summary: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy announced AWS cloud capacity is largely sold out through 2027, with commitments extending into 2028, driven by unprecedented enterprise demand for AI infrastructure.
stories.why: Highlights severe hyperscaler compute constraints, forcing product leaders to lock in multi-year infrastructure commitments early.

stories.title: Now Google says it might use your Gmail and Google Photos data to target ads
stories.summary: Google updated its privacy policy to state that personal data from Gmail and Photos accessed via AI features can now be used for targeted ads, reversing a longstanding privacy pledge.
stories.why: Significant data privacy shift that product managers must consider when building trusted consumer or enterprise AI workflows.

stories.title: China's Moonshot AI launches Kimi K3.1 Pro; plans full model weights release by November
stories.summary: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3.1 Pro, an open-weight 3-trillion-parameter model with a 1-million-token context window, while restricting autonomous hacking capabilities ahead of its November weights release.
stories.why: Accelerates open-weight frontier model capabilities, intensifying pressure on proprietary US foundation model pricing and margins.

stories.title: UK government sets out $800 million for AI security funding
stories.summary: The UK pledged $800 million for AI security, including £100 million for the world’s first national AI biosecurity lab developed in partnership with OpenAI and Anthropic.
stories.why: Sets a precedent for state-backed frontier AI risk infrastructure, focusing heavily on chemical and biological defense.

stories.title: AI Responsible For 10.5% Of Infosys' Overall Revenues In Q2 FY27
stories.summary: Infosys revealed that artificial intelligence accounted for 10.5% of total revenue in Q2 FY27, powered by a 29% year-on-year surge in enterprise AI customer engagements.
stories.why: Provides hard financial metrics proving Indian IT service giants are successfully monetizing enterprise generative AI transformation contracts.

related.title: Indian IT stocks post best weekly gain in 18 years amid global AI sell-off

stories.title: Coforge Revenue Rises 54% as AI Engineering and Deal Bookings Gain Momentum
stories.summary: Coforge reported a 53.6% year-on-year revenue surge in Q2 FY27 and raised full-year EBIT margin guidance to 16%, crediting proprietary AI engineering and robust deal bookings.
stories.why: Proves mid-tier Indian IT firms can expand operating margins through structured AI workflow automation and tooling.

stories.title: Comm min identifying AI-proof professions, sectors where India can take global lead: Goyal
stories.summary: India's Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal announced initiatives to identify AI-resilient professions and sectors where India can build global leadership by leveraging skilled talent alongside AI productivity.
stories.why: Guides workforce planning, enterprise hiring strategies, and policy support across Indian tech and knowledge-economy hubs.

related.title: A quarter of Indian workers now in AI-exposed occupations: CEA

stories.title: Elvis Presley Rightsholders Sue Anthropic for Training on 274 Songs Without Permission
stories.summary: Rightsholders of Elvis Presley sued Anthropic, alleging the AI lab committed massive copyright infringement by unlawfully training its Claude models on 274 copyrighted musical works.
stories.why: Expands intellectual property litigation beyond text to music, heightening legal risks and licensing costs for model builders.

related.title: Sony and UMG are suing Suno again

stories.title: Bitcoin Core Rewrites Its Security Policy for a World Where AI Finds Bugs in One Prompt
stories.summary: Bitcoin Core updated its vulnerability disclosure policies after observing that AI models can now surface critical software vulnerabilities within a single prompt.
stories.why: Signals a turning point for open-source software security as AI radically lowers the barrier to finding zero-days.

stories.title: Pathos AI Raises $237M Series E at ~$3B Valuation, Led by Bristol Myers Squibb
stories.summary: Pathos AI raised a $237 million Series E round at a $3 billion valuation led by Bristol Myers Squibb to accelerate AI-enabled drug development.
stories.why: Demonstrates Big Pharma’s strategy of taking direct equity stakes in AI biotech platforms to de-risk clinical discovery.

related.title: Pathos AI teams up with Bristol Myers and Tempus AI to advance drug development

stories.title: Pigment Raises $250m for Enterprise Planning Capabilities
stories.summary: Enterprise business planning platform Pigment raised $250 million to advance its AI-driven forecasting and financial modeling capabilities for global corporations.
stories.why: Underscores persistent enterprise venture demand for vertical AI platforms modernizing legacy corporate financial planning and analysis.

stories.title: Jack Dorsey’s Block made an AI model that talks to you like an awkward new friend
stories.summary: Jack Dorsey’s Block launched Dessa, an AI voice model trained entirely on human conversation that can run locally on an Apple M4 Max chip.
stories.why: Highlights advancements in low-latency, on-device voice AI that bypass costly cloud infrastructure and preserve user privacy.

stories.title: OpenAI Expands Decisions API, Scales Enterprise Push With Uber and Cuts Frontier Training Off From the Live Internet
stories.summary: OpenAI transitioned its Decisions API out of beta with integrated voice support and expanded its enterprise footprint by onboarding Uber.
stories.why: Strengthens OpenAI’s push into autonomous agent workflows, competing directly for enterprise operational decision-making budgets.

related.title: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up

stories.title: Cortex DC plans 2 GW of AI-ready data centre capacity across India over seven years
stories.summary: Cortex DC announced plans to deploy 2 gigawatts of AI-ready data center capacity across India over the next seven years to address surging computational requirements.
stories.why: Crucial physical capacity expansion addressing India’s severe data center power and GPU hosting constraints.

related.title: India's data centre capacity may surge to 24-26 GW, impact on overall power demand to remain limited: CEA Chairman
AI data-centre boom puts India’s power grid under pressure, drives up upgrade costs

stories.title: Pennsylvania will require labels on AI-generated ads
stories.summary: Pennsylvania enacted the Artificial Intelligence Deceptive Advertising Act, mandating clear disclosure labels on all advertisements created or significantly altered by AI technology.
stories.why: Imposes statutory disclosure rules that product teams and marketers must engineer into automated generative ad systems.
